paragraphs_en: 2026 Meadowlands turf: NJRC approval counts nine days; operator event listings currently show eight, including the upcoming October 16 meeting. The unlisted September 26 date is not established as cancelled.
This is one state, one venue and one Thoroughbred subset only. U.S. Standardbred and other codes need their own sources; Equibase is reference only.
paragraphs_ja: 2026年メドウランズ芝競走は州承認資料9日、運営者の現行イベント一覧8日。10月16日は掲載されているが、9月26日の欠落だけで中止とは判定しない。
New Jersey州の1競馬場・1体系のみの部分対応。繋駕速歩等の他体系は別ソースが必要で、Equibaseは照合資料とする。

calendar_guidance_en: Publish only currently source-visible 2026 Meadowlands Thoroughbred turf dates at C; do not use Equibase as an automated U.S. source or generalize to a national feed. A missing approved day in operator event listings is not cancellation evidence.

coverage_note_en: Only the NJ Meadowlands Thoroughbred turf 2026 subset is active, not all U.S. Thoroughbred or Standardbred, Quarter Horse, Arabian, steeplechase or fair circuits. Puerto Rico is separately tracked.
